subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: For this Android report, should maintainers preserve the current explicit `gateway.nodes.allowCommands` and in-app capability gates while fixing docs/live bugs, or change which Android camera/location/canvas commands become usable by default?
rationale: Camera capture and location are sensitive node capabilities, and the observed `node command not allowed` behavior may be expected security policy for `camera.snap` but not for `location.get` or A2UI host readiness.

options.title: Preserve gates and fix proven bugs
options.body: Keep `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` opt-in, improve docs/onboarding diagnostics, and only patch Android location/A2UI paths after live reproduction proves a runtime bug.

options.title: Broaden Android defaults
options.body: Make more Android commands usable by default, accepting a larger camera/location security surface that must be covered by explicit security review and tests.

options.title: Split into narrower issues
options.body: Track `camera.snap` policy/docs, `location.get` advertisement, and A2UI host readiness separately if maintainers want independent ownership and release timing.

recommendation.title: Preserve gates and fix proven bugs
recommendation.body: Keep `camera.snap`/`camera.clip` opt-in, improve docs/onboarding diagnostics, and only patch Android location/A2UI paths after live reproduction proves a runtime bug.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is primarily Android app capability/runtime behavior, and @obviyus is the documented Android app contact.
